text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket seems to be having 
trouble...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Mmmmmm... My skin feels kinda dry and 
rough.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Why did it turn out like this...? Hey, 
Trainer, what do you think?
choice_data_list:
Could you be lacking nutrients or 
something?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hm-hmm, I'm eating plenty, don't worry~! 
You can't give it your all unless you eat 
a ton!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I've been super into sweet snacks lately! 
They're delicious, give you tons of 
energy, and are just the best!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I figured with the power of sweets, 
training would go with a huge BAM!!, so—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday, for breakfast, lunch, and 
dinner—all of them! I had super meals 
packed full of snacks!

Winning Ticket didn't seem to realize it, 
but it looked like her poor diet had 
caused a skin breakout...
